marks: Marked by fire: something always burns nearby.
Marked by frost: breath fogs in all weathers.
Marked by shadow: their silhouette sometimes moves wrong.
Marked by tide: water finds them wherever they hide.
Marked by stone: scars look like cracks in rock.
Marked by wind: hair perpetually unsettled.
Marked by blood: wounds close fast but ache long.
Marked by void: their reflection is always a moment behind.
flaws: Keeps the wrong secrets for the wrong people.
Trusts their gut over all evidence to the contrary.
Cannot let a wrong go unanswered.

weapons.name: Hunting Bow
weapons.flavor: Feeds you before it defends you.

weapons.name: Curved Sword
weapons.flavor: Favored where dueling is an art.

weapons.name: Longknife
weapons.flavor: Too long to be honest, too short to be proud.

tools.name: Map Case
tools.flavor: Half the maps are wrong. Which half?

traits: Speaks rarely; means everything they say.
Always knows which way is north.
Keeps a tally of what they owe and what they're owed.
Wakes before dawn. Cannot explain why.
Collects stones from rivers they cross.
Has a tell when lying: touches their left wrist.
drives: To repay a debt older than memory.
To find whatever was taken from them.
To protect something fragile from a world that isn't.
To earn a name worth passing down.
To reach the end of a road that keeps extending.
To undo one specific thing they did.
To find out if they were right about someone.
To outlast everyone who said they wouldn't.
